description: This file contains a PHP class 'ViewHome' which extends 'SugarView' and manages the display of the home view for the ModuleBuilder component in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for rendering the interface, generating buttons, and integrating with AJAX.

classes.name: ViewHome
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for rendering the home interface of the ModuleBuilder module in SuiteCRM, including generating UI buttons and handling AJAX interactions.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for display, incorporating localization and current module context.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the home view, setting up Smarty template variables and initializing AJAX components.

methods.name: generateHomeButtons
methods.description: Creates an array of action buttons for the home view based on user permissions and context.
